# Schulman Vein and Laser Center

> New York's premier vein specialists. All We Do Is Veins™. Board-certified vein doctors serving Manhattan, Manhasset, and Commack with 55+ years of combined experience.

Schulman Vein and Laser Center is a medical practice exclusively dedicated to the diagnosis and non-surgical treatment of vein disease. Every patient is personally treated by Dr. Martin L. Schulman or Dr. Lee G. Schulman — never by nurses, students, or interns. All treatments are non-surgical, FDA-approved, and allow patients to drive themselves home the same day.

## Business Information

- **Full name:** Schulman Vein and Laser Center
- **Tagline:** "All We Do Is Veins™"
- **Specialty:** Phlebology (vein disease)
- **Type:** Medical practice — vein-only
- **Founded:** Over 55 years of combined experience
- **Website:** https://www.schulmanveincenter.com

## Physicians

### Dr. Martin L. Schulman, M.D.
Board-certified vascular surgeon and phlebologist. One of the first certified vascular surgeons in the United States. Delivered over 79 international lectures on vein disease. Former Chief of Vascular Surgery at North Shore University Hospital. Authored multiple peer-reviewed publications on sclerotherapy and phlebology.

### Dr. Lee G. Schulman, M.D.
Diplomate in Phlebology (#00045 — among the first certified). One of the first physicians in the world to lecture on hand vein treatment. Internationally recognized expert in sclerotherapy and venous disease.

## Services

- **Varicose Vein Treatment** — micro ambulatory phlebectomy and ultrasound-guided sclerotherapy for bulging varicose veins
- **Spider Vein Treatment** — injection sclerotherapy (microinjection) for cosmetic spider veins
- **Endovenous Laser Therapy (EVLT)** — ultrasound-assisted laser ablation for saphenous vein reflux
- **Hand & Body Vein Treatment** — removal of prominent hand and body surface veins
- **Phlebitis Treatment** — treatment of superficial and deep vein inflammation
- **Venous Leg Ulcer Treatment** — management and closure of venous ulcers caused by chronic venous insufficiency

## Key Differentiators

- 100% vein-only practice — no generalists, no divided attention
- Every patient personally treated by one of the two doctors
- Non-surgical methods exclusively — no cutting, no scarring
- FDA-approved treatments only
- Same-day recovery — drive yourself home immediately after treatment
- Free initial vein screening consultation
- Techniques pioneered by the Schulmans are now used by vein specialists worldwide

## Conditions Treated

Varicose veins, spider veins, reticular veins, chronic venous insufficiency (CVI), phlebitis, superficial thrombophlebitis, venous leg ulcers, hand vein prominence, post-sclerotherapy matting, symptomatic leg heaviness and swelling.
